import { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (hitType === 'shield') return { text, color: '#62cfff', italic: false };
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
    const existing=numbers.findLast(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&!number.closed);

/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent),overclockingStats(character).atk]);
}


/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
function beginPoseTransition(character) {
  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };
  }
}

/** Render one pose with shared scale and measured foot anchors, including effects. */
function drawPose(character, pose, opacity) {
  opacity *= character.death?.opacity ?? 1;
  const crop = pose.crop;
  const displaySize = character.spriteSize || spriteSize;
  const scale = (displaySize - spritePadding * 2) / (character.referenceSize || 215);
  const width = crop.width * scale;
  const height = crop.height * scale;
  const drawY = displaySize / 2 - spritePadding - (crop.footY - crop.y) * scale + enemyBounceOffset(character);
  const drawX = crop.anchorX === undefined ? -width / 2 : -(crop.anchorX - crop.x) * scale;
  // Match attack hurtboxes to the rendered pose without changing contact-damage hitboxes.
  character.spriteHurtbox=animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,spritePadding);
  context.save();
  context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  context.translate(character.x - camera.x, character.y - camera.y + (character.bossVisualOffsetY||0));
  if(character.bossSquash) {
    const feet=drawY+(crop.footY-crop.y)*scale;
    context.translate(0,feet);
    context.scale(1+(1-character.bossSquash)*.3,character.bossSquash);
    context.translate(0,-feet);
  }
  if (pose.mirrored) context.scale(-1, 1);
  if ((character===characters[selected]||character.isPlayerVisual)&&character.tuningParts&&reverseTuningUpsideDown(character)) {
    const centerY=drawY+height/2;
    context.translate(0,centerY);context.scale(1,-1);context.translate(0,-centerY);
  }
  context.drawImage(character.image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
    drawX, drawY, width, height);
  const flash = character.death
    ? 0.95 * Math.min(1, character.death.elapsed / 0.035)
    : Math.max(character.ultimateWhite||0,getDamageFlashOpacity(character));
  if (flash > 0) {
    context.globalAlpha = opacity * flash;
    context.drawImage(getWhiteSprite(character.image), crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      drawX, drawY, width, height);
    context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  }
  if (showSpriteBounds) {
    context.strokeStyle = '#e54b93';
    context.strokeRect(drawX, drawY, width, height);
    const body = getCombatHitbox(character, character !== characters[selected]);

/** Put tall map objects in front of actors walking behind their solid bases. */
function drawCharacterOcclusion(character) {
  if (enemyRenderLayer(character) !== 'normal') return; // Specials and bosses appear above map foregrounds.

}

import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

/** Test a segment against sprite rectangles or the existing contact ellipses. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {

      const delta=end-start;

/** Conservative broadphase only; callers retain their existing exact collision tests. */
export function createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies, getBounds, cellSize=128) {
  const cells=new Map();
  enemies.forEach((enemy,order)=>{
    const b=getBounds(enemy),entry={enemy,order};
    for(let y=Math.floor((b.y-b.ry)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((b.y+b.ry)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((b.x-b.rx)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((b.x+b.rx)/cellSize);x++) {
        const key=x+','+y;
        let bucket=cells.get(key);if(!bucket)cells.set(key,bucket=[]);
        bucket.push(entry);
      }
  });
  return {querySegment(from,to,padding=0) {
    const found=new Set();
    for(let y=Math.floor((Math.min(from.y,to.y)-padding)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.y,to.y)+padding)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((Math.min(from.x,to.x)-padding)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.x,to.x)+padding)/cellSize);x++)
        for(const entry of cells.get(x+','+y)||[])found.add(entry);
    // Preserve Map insertion order: piercing limits and random damage rolls depend on it.
    return [...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.enemy);
  }};
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  if(npc.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, npc.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(damage*weakenedAttackMultiplier(npc)):damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) {player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;npc.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;}
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
  }
  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
  return pauseChase;
}

export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  if(npc.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, npc.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(damage*weakenedAttackMultiplier(npc)):damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) {player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;npc.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;}
  }

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true, highlightStats = false } = {}) {
  canvas.setAttribute('data-bitmap-text','');
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0,index=0;const highlights=highlightStats?statHighlightRanges(line):[];
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          const highlighted=highlights.some(range=>index>=range.start&&index<range.end);
          const source=highlighted?yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character):image;
          context.drawImage(source, highlighted?0:glyph.x, highlighted?0:glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
        index+=character.length;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();

/** Wire admin progression/HP controls to the currently controlled character. */
export function createPlayerStatsTools(getPlayer, onChange) {
  const panel = document.querySelector('#player-stats-tools');
  const expAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="exp-amount"]');
  const hpAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="hp-amount"]');
  const shieldAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="shield-amount"]');
  const invincibility = document.querySelector('#player-invincibility');
  const status = document.querySelector('#player-stats-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#player-stats-feedback');
  const statInputs = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-combat-stat]')];
  let inspectedCharacter;

  // Apply on change so typing is not interrupted by per-frame HUD refreshes.
  for (const input of statInputs) {
    input.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const value = Number(input.value);
      const maximum = input.dataset.combatStat === 'critPercent' ? 100 : 1000;
      const stats = ensureCombatStats(getPlayer());
      if (Number.isFinite(value)) stats[input.dataset.combatStat] = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, value));
      input.value = stats[input.dataset.combatStat];
      onChange(getPlayer());
    });
  }

  /** Keep toggles and inspection values synchronized across character swaps. */
  function update() {
    const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
    invincibility.checked = character.invincible;
    for (const input of statInputs) {
      if (inspectedCharacter !== character || document.activeElement !== input) input.value = character.combatStats[input.dataset.combatStat];
    }
    inspectedCharacter = character;
    status.textContent = `${character.label} | LV ${character.level} | EXP ${character.exp}/${character.maxExp} | HP ${character.hp}/${character.maxHp} | Shield ${totalPlayerShield(character)}/${character.maxHp}`;
  }
  invincibility.addEventListener('change', () => {
    getPlayer().invincible = invincibility.checked;
    feedback.textContent = invincibility.checked ? 'Death protection enabled; HP can still reach zero.' : 'Death protection disabled.';
    update();
  });
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-player-stat]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
      const action = button.dataset.playerStat;
      const amount = Number(action === 'exp' ? expAmount.value : action.startsWith('shield-') ? shieldAmount.value : hpAmount.value);
      if (['exp', 'damage', 'heal', 'shield-add', 'shield-remove'].includes(action) &&
          (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount < 1 || amount > 1000000)) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Enter an amount from 1 to 1,000,000.';
        return;

export { startingLevelExp, expIncreasePerLevel } from './game-config.js';

// Level costs and formulas live in game-config.js.



/** Add round(15 + currentLevel / 2) to the next requirement on each level-up. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  return levelExpFormula(level);
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.pendingUpgrades ??= 0;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  syncRacerPassHealth(character);
  syncLifeJacketShield(character);
  character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield ?? 0));
  character.invincible ??= developmentSettings.invincible;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.pendingUpgrades++; // Each gained level gets its own choice, including overflow.
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
    character.hp = character.maxHp; // Every level-up fully restores health.
  }
}

export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);

/** One-hit missiles choose random visible targets, then retain their launch trajectory. */

Currently, Throwing Cards uses:

`speed in pixels/second = listed projectile speed × 60`

So **10 = 600 px/s**, or **10 pixels per frame at 60 FPS**. That measures travel along the spiral, not straight outward movement.

The card’s visual spin is separate, currently **24 radians/second**.

import { throwingCardsSettings, throwingCardsLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';

/** Invert spiral arc length so projectile speed is constant while its orbit expands. */
export function throwingCardSpiral(age,startRadius=32){
 const pitch=throwingCardsSettings.pitch,distance=throwingCardsSettings.speed*Math.max(0,age);
 const primitive=r=>(r*Math.hypot(r,pitch)+pitch*pitch*Math.asinh(r/pitch))/2;
 const target=primitive(startRadius)+pitch*distance;let radius=Math.sqrt(startRadius*startRadius+2*pitch*distance);
 for(let i=0;i<6;i++)radius-=(primitive(radius)-target)/Math.hypot(radius,pitch);
 return {radius,angle:(radius-startRadius)/pitch};
}
export function createThrowingCardsAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=throwingCardsSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,cards=[],shots=0,image=null;
 const ready=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{image=new Image();image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=()=>{image=null;resolve();};image.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Card Set.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;cards=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,angle){
  const stats=throwingCardsLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),orbitScale=weaponSizeMultiplier(player),size=stats.size*orbitScale;
  const startRadius=(Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)+s.hitRadius*size+3)/orbitScale;
  cards.push({x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*startRadius*orbitScale,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*startRadius*orbitScale,angle,age:0,startRadius,orbitScale,size,duration:stats.duration,hitsLeft:stats.hitLimit,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;
 }
 function update(delta,player,angle=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='throwing-cards');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,angle);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(throwingCardsLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   if(!cards.length)continue;
   if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   for(let i=cards.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=cards[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;
    if(b.age>b.duration+1e-8){cards.splice(i,1);continue;}
    const spiral=throwingCardSpiral(b.age/b.orbitScale,b.startRadius),a=b.angle+spiral.angle;
    b.x=center.x+Math.cos(a)*spiral.radius*b.orbitScale;b.y=center.y+Math.sin(a)*spiral.radius*b.orbitScale;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.size;
    const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{
     if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;
     const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);
    });
    candidates.sort((a,c)=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(a),u=getEnemyHurtbox(c);return Math.hypot(t.x-from.x,t.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(u.x-from.x,u.y-from.y);});
    for(const enemy of candidates){
     if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))continue;
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'throwing-cards',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'throwing-cards'});
     b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'throwing-cards'})===false)continue;
     b.hitsLeft--;if(b.hitsLeft<=0)break;
    }
    if(b.hitsLeft<=0||b.age>=b.duration-1e-8)cards.splice(i,1);
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  for(const b of cards){context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.angle+b.age*s.spinSpeed);context.scale(b.size,b.size);
   if(image?.complete&&image.naturalWidth){

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
 });
}

import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

import { beginKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Books materialize equally spaced around the player; each owns its hit budget/cooldown. */
export function createStudentHandbookAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=studentHandbookSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,books=[],shots=0,image=null;
 const ready=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{image=new Image();image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=()=>{image=null;resolve();};image.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Arius Student Handbook.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;books=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,angle){
  const stats=studentHandbookLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=weaponSizeMultiplier(player),radius=s.orbitRadius*area;
  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'student-handbook',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const phase=angle+i*Math.PI*2/count;books.push({x:body.x+Math.cos(phase)*radius,y:body.y+Math.sin(phase)*radius,phase,angle:phase,age:0,area,radius,count,duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hitsLeft:s.hitLimit,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 }
 function update(delta,player,angle=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='student-handbook');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,angle);cooldown=Math.max(s.minimumInterval,attackTimeFormula(s.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent));}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   if(!books.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   for(let i=books.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=books[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;if(b.age>b.duration+1e-8){books.splice(i,1);continue;}
    b.angle=b.phase+s.speed/b.radius*b.age;b.x=center.x+Math.cos(b.angle)*b.radius;b.y=center.y+Math.sin(b.angle)*b.radius;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.area;
    const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
    for(const enemy of candidates){
     if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))continue;b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'student-handbook',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'student-handbook'});
     if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'student-handbook'})===false)continue;
     b.hitsLeft--;const target=getEnemy(enemy.id);
     if(target){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),direction=Math.atan2(body.y-center.y,body.x-center.x),distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
      const motion=beginKnockback(target,Math.cos(direction)*distance,Math.sin(direction)*distance,s.knockbackSeconds);
      if(motion){target.skillKnockback=motion;target.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(target.knockbackMovementRemaining||0,s.knockbackSeconds);}
     }
     if(b.hitsLeft<=0)break;
    }
    if(b.hitsLeft<=0||b.age>=b.duration-1e-8)books.splice(i,1);
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  if(!image?.complete||!image.naturalWidth)return;
  for(const b of books){context.save();context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,b.age/.1,(b.duration-b.age)/.1);context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(Math.sin(b.angle)*.12);context.scale(b.area,b.area);context.drawImage(image,48,12,200,228,-s.width/2,-s.height/2,s.width,s.height);context.restore();}
 }

}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {rgbTuningActive,rainbowTrailGradient,rainbowPlasmaColor} from './rgb-tuning.js';
import { luminousNovaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',iconRotation:-45,exSkill:true};
}
export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale) {
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

    const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
    const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/origin.rx,dy/origin.ry);

Moustache Medal



**Moustache Medal** is a weapon in *Orbitrail*. It is unlocked by surviving for at least 10 minutes in a single run with Plana. (will change condition later)



Moustache Medal creates a wall behind the character that knocks back enemies in the way. It is more effective on flat characters.



### Weapon type

Basic

### Shot type

Ranged

### Description

Create a defensive wall that damages targets behind you. Effectiveness is increased on certain characters.

- Cutting Board is affected by the area increase of Racer Pass
- Cutting Board pushes back targets hit.
- Damage and area are increased by 30% (multiplicative) on "flat" characters.
- See Behavior for more details.



## Upgrades

| **Level 1**   | Create a defensive wall that damages targets behind you. Effectiveness is increased on certain characters. |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Level 2**   | Increase size of wall by 30%.                                                                              |
| **Level 3**   | Increase damage by 30%.                                                                                    |
| **Level 4**   | Walls travel farther.                                                                                      |
| **Level 5**   | Increase damage by 50%.                                                                                    |
| **Level 6**   | Reduce the time between attacks by 0.5 seconds.                                                            |
| **Level MAX** | Shoot additional walls from sides.                                                                         |

## Behavior

When equipped, a cutting board projectile spawns from the player's position and moves towards the opposite direction of where the player is going (e.g. if the player is moving to the right, the projectile moves to the left). When upgraded to level MAX two additional projectiles are fired, one for the left- and right-hand side of the player. A projectile will never spawn in front of the player.



Flat Character Bonus (idk if this was implemented yet)



**Flat** is a flag for the characters that determines if the **Cutting Board** weapon will give a bonus or not. If a flat character uses the **Cutting Board** weapon, the spawned **Cutting Board** projectile will be 30% bigger than normal, and will also deal 30% more damage. This bonus also applies to the [not added synnergy weapon yet] and [not added either] synnergy weapons.

/** Books grow out from the player and shrink back into the player within their lifetime. */
export function studentHandbookPose(age,duration,retiringAt=null,retiringScale=1){
 const smooth=t=>{const p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return p*p*(3-2*p);};
 const scale=retiringAt===null?Math.min(smooth(age/studentHandbookSettings.emergeSeconds),smooth((duration-age)/studentHandbookSettings.returnSeconds)):
  retiringScale*(1-smooth((age-retiringAt)/studentHandbookSettings.returnSeconds));
 return {scale,alpha:scale};
}

import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration, artilleryExplosionReady } from './artillery-explosion.js';

/** Nearby-target launch, timed return, or one explosion when its accepted hit budget ends. */
export function createOrbitalCompassAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=orbitalCompassSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,needles=[],explosions=[],shots=0,bursts=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;needles=[];explosions=[];shots=0;bursts=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,aim){
  const stats=orbitalCompassLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=stats.size*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'orbital-compass',stats.count);
  const targets=getAllEnemies().map(enemy=>({enemy,body:getEnemyHurtbox(enemy)})).filter(t=>t.enemy.hp>0&&Math.hypot(t.body.x-body.x,t.body.y-body.y)<=s.acquireRange).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.body.x-body.x,a.body.y-body.y)-Math.hypot(b.body.x-body.x,b.body.y-body.y));
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets[i%targets.length]?.body;let angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x):aim+i*Math.PI*2/count;
   if(target&&targets.length<count)angle+=(i-(count-1)/2)*.12;
   needles.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,angle,rotation:angle,age:0,area,count,hitsLeft:stats.hitLimit,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;
  }
 }
 function roll(player,b,target,explosion=false){
  const base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'orbital-compass',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:(explosion?s.explosionHitCooldown:s.hitCooldown)*60});
  return rollAttackDamage(player,base*(explosion?s.explosionDamage/s.damage:1),random,{target,weaponId:'orbital-compass'});
 }
 function explode(player,b){
  const effect={x:b.x,y:b.y,radius:s.hitRadius*b.area*s.explosionArea,age:0};explosions.push(effect);bursts++;
  // The blast is a single accepted hit per target, not periodic damage from the visual animation.
  for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){

import {recordRateUpHit} from './rate-up-tuning.js';
import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import { midoriDodges } from './midori.js';
import { enemyPopulationSettings, harmlessEnemySettings } from './game-config.js';
export { enemyPopulationSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { isAdminSeed } from './run-seed.js';
// Persistent-in-session enemy state is separate from disposable background tiles.
// Future enemy spawning should register world coordinates here, never screen X/Y.
import { dropEnemyExp, dropEnemyLoot, dropYuukaCredits } from './exp-drops.js';
import { beginEnemyDeath } from './enemy-death.js';
import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';



/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || ['iroha', 'shiroko', 'arisu', 'neru'].includes(enemy.type);
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
const damageListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

export const enemyTestConfig = { oneHp: isAdminSeed };
const savedEnemyHealth = new WeakMap();

/** Toggle 1-HP enemies for this session, including elites, bosses and future spawns. */
export function setOneHpEnemies(enabled) {
  enemyTestConfig.oneHp = Boolean(enabled);
  for (const enemy of enemies.values()) applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
}

/** Preserve normal health so disabling the test restores surviving enemies. */
function applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy) {
  if (enemyTestConfig.oneHp) {
    if (!savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, { hp: enemy.hp, maxHp: enemy.maxHp });
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp = 1;
  } else if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) {
    Object.assign(enemy, savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy));
    savedEnemyHealth.delete(enemy);
  }
}

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}
export function onEnemyDefeat(listener) {
  defeatListeners.add(listener);
  return () => defeatListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Count confirmed defeats for this session; admin removal does not count. */
export function getKillCount() {
  return killCount;
}

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Observe accepted HP damage, excluding misses, overkill and forced harmless-enemy removal. */
export function onEnemyDamage(listener) {
  damageListeners.add(listener);return ()=>damageListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  const saved = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemies.get(id));
  if (saved) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, saved);
  applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal', options = {}) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  if (options.instantKO && (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.miniBoss || enemy.instantKOImmune)) return false;
  if (options.canMiss && midoriDodges(enemy, source)) {
    showDamageNumber(enemy, 0, false, 'miss');
    return false;
  }
  const mainWeaponId=source?.mainWeaponId??(source?.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(source?.tuningParts&&options.weaponId===mainWeaponId)recordRateUpHit(enemy,tuningPerk(source.tuningParts,'rateUpChance'));
  const harmless = ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type);
  if (harmless) {
    dropYuukaCredits(enemy); // Each accepted hit, including the final hit.
    enemy.receivedHits = (enemy.receivedHits || 0) + 1;
  }
  const requiredHits = harmless ? (enemy.hitsToDefeat ?? harmlessEnemySettings[`${enemy.type}HitsToDefeat`]) : null;
  const actualDamage=Math.min(enemy.hp,amount);
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  // Count accepted hits, not damage points; misses and rejected hits never reach this branch.
  if (Number.isFinite(requiredHits) && requiredHits >= 1 && enemy.receivedHits >= requiredHits) enemy.hp = 0;
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType, options.damageGroup); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore, source, weaponId:options.weaponId, hitType });
  }
  // Notify after resolving this hit's defeat, so secondary effects cannot double-count its kill.
  for(const listener of damageListeners)listener({enemy,source,damage:actualDamage,requestedDamage:amount,hitType,weaponId:options.weaponId,
    isCritical:options.isCritical??['critical','orangecritical','supercritical'].includes(hitType),triggersSkills:options.triggersSkills!==false});
  return enemy;
}

export function endEventEnemies(eventKey, source) {
  if (!eventKey) return 0;
  let removed = 0;

import { orbitalCompassSettings, orbitalCompassLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration, artilleryExplosionReady } from './artillery-explosion.js';

/** Nearby-target launch, timed return, or one explosion when its accepted hit budget ends. */
export function createOrbitalCompassAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=orbitalCompassSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,needles=[],explosions=[],shots=0,bursts=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;needles=[];explosions=[];shots=0;bursts=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,aim){
  const stats=orbitalCompassLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=stats.size*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'orbital-compass',stats.count);
  const targets=getAllEnemies().map(enemy=>({enemy,body:getEnemyHurtbox(enemy)})).filter(t=>t.enemy.hp>0&&Math.hypot(t.body.x-body.x,t.body.y-body.y)<=s.acquireRange).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.body.x-body.x,a.body.y-body.y)-Math.hypot(b.body.x-body.x,b.body.y-body.y));
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets[i%targets.length]?.body;let angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x):aim+i*Math.PI*2/count;
   if(target&&targets.length<count)angle+=(i-(count-1)/2)*.12;
   needles.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,angle,rotation:angle,age:0,area,count,hitsLeft:stats.hitLimit,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;
  }
 }
 function roll(player,b,target,explosion=false){
  const base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'orbital-compass',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:(explosion?s.explosionHitCooldown:s.hitCooldown)*60});
  return rollAttackDamage(player,base*(explosion?s.explosionDamage/s.damage:1),random,{target,weaponId:'orbital-compass'});
 }
 function explode(player,b){
  const effect={x:b.x,y:b.y,radius:s.hitRadius*b.area*s.explosionArea,age:0};explosions.push(effect);bursts++;
  // The blast is a single accepted hit per target, not periodic damage from the visual animation.
  for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){
   const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=body.x-effect.x,dy=body.y-effect.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/body.rx,dy/distance/body.ry):0;
   if(distance>effect.radius+extent)continue;const hit=roll(player,b,enemy,true);damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'orbital-compass'});
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,aim=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='orbital-compass');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,aim);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(s.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   for(let i=explosions.length-1;i>=0;i--){explosions[i].age+=dt;if(explosions[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)explosions.splice(i,1);}
   if(!needles.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   for(let i=needles.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=needles[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;if(b.age>s.duration+1e-8){needles.splice(i,1);continue;}
    if(b.age>=s.returnAfter){const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false),dx=center.x-b.x,dy=center.y-b.y;if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<=s.speed*dt+1){needles.splice(i,1);continue;}b.angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);}
    b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*s.speed*dt;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*s.speed*dt;b.rotation+=s.spinSpeed*dt;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.area;
    const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
    candidates.sort((a,c)=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(a),u=getEnemyHurtbox(c);return Math.hypot(t.x-from.x,t.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(u.x-from.x,u.y-from.y);});
    let exploded=false;
    for(const enemy of candidates){if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))continue;b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);const hit=roll(player,b,enemy);
     if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'orbital-compass'})===false)continue;
     b.hitsLeft--;if(b.hitsLeft<=0){explode(player,b);exploded=true;break;}
    }
    if(exploded||b.age>=s.duration-1e-8)needles.splice(i,1);
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  for(const b of needles){context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.rotation);context.scale(b.area,b.area);
   context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-s.length/2,0);context.lineTo(0,-s.width/2);context.lineTo(s.length/2,0);context.lineTo(0,s.width/2);context.closePath();context.fillStyle='#d9edfa';context.fill();context.strokeStyle='#47667a';context.lineWidth=1.2;context.stroke();
   context.beginPath();context.moveTo(0,-s.width/2);context.lineTo(s.length/2,0);context.lineTo(0,s.width/2);context.closePath();context.fillStyle='#ed6f85';context.fill();
   context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,3,0,Math.PI*2);context.fillStyle='#e8d497';context.fill();context.restore();
  }
  for(const effect of explosions)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);
 }
 return {ready:artilleryExplosionReady,update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return needles.length;},get explosionCount(){return explosions.length;},get burstsFired(){return bursts;}};
}

import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';
import { createSportsDrink, sportsDrinkDescription, createMalkuthHat, createRacerPass, createSafetyHelmet, createLifeJacket, createChisePlushie, createOverheatedOverclocking, createSpecialPharmaceuticals } from './item-catalog.js';
/** Repeat equip clicks level owned basic weapons; never awaken or enhance them. */
export function equipAdminWeapon(player,createWeapon){
  const candidate=createWeapon(),slots=player.attackSlots??=[],owned=slots.find(w=>w?.id===candidate.id);
  if(owned){
    const maximum=owned.isSynergy?1:(owned.maxLevel??candidate.maxLevel??7);
    const next=Math.min(maximum,(owned.level||1)+1);
    if(next>(owned.level||1)){owned.level=next;recordWeaponMax(player,owned);}
    return true;
  }
  const empty=slots.findIndex(w=>!w);
  if(empty>=0)slots[empty]=candidate;else if(slots.length<6)slots.push(candidate);else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,candidate);return true;
}
/** Manual equips bypass reward unlocks without permanently unlocking items. */
export function equipAdminItem(player,item){
  const slots=player.equipmentSlots??=[],owned=slots.findIndex(owned=>owned?.id===item.id),empty=slots.findIndex(owned=>!owned);
  const index=owned>=0?owned:empty>=0?empty:slots.length;
  if(index>=6)return false;
  const current=owned>=0?slots[owned]:null;
  if(current&&!item.isSuper&&!item.awakened){
    if(!current.isSuper&&!current.awakened){
      const maximum=current.maxLevel??item.maxLevel??3;
      if((current.level||1)<maximum)current.level=(current.level||1)+1;
      else if(item.id==='sports-drink')slots[index]=createSportsDrink(true);
      else if(item.id==='malkuth-hat')slots[index]=createMalkuthHat(true);
      else if(item.id==='racer-pass')slots[index]=createRacerPass(true);
      else if(item.id==='safety-helmet')slots[index]=createSafetyHelmet(true);
      else if(item.id==='life-jacket')slots[index]=createLifeJacket(true);
      else if(item.id==='overheated-overclocking')slots[index]=createOverheatedOverclocking(true);
    }
  }else if(!current||!current.isSuper&&!current.awakened){slots[index]={...item};}
  return true;
}
export function createItemEquipAdmin({root,getPlayer,onChange=()=>{}}){
  const status=document.createElement('p');status.className='admin-equip-status';status.setAttribute('role','status');
  const options=[
    {label:"Equip Sports Drink",create:()=>createSportsDrink()},
    {label:"Equip Malkuth's Hat",create:()=>createMalkuthHat()},
    {label:'Equip Racer Pass',create:()=>createRacerPass()},
    {label:'Equip Safety Helmet',create:()=>createSafetyHelmet()},
    {label:'Equip Life Jacket',create:()=>createLifeJacket()},
    {label:'Equip Chise Plushie',create:()=>createChisePlushie()},
    {label:'Equip Special Pharmaceuticals',create:()=>createSpecialPharmaceuticals()},
    {label:'Equip Overheated Overclocking',create:()=>createOverheatedOverclocking()}
  ];
  for(const option of options){
    const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.textContent=option.label;button.title='Equip, level up, then click once more at MAX for its defined Super/Awakened form.';
    button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const player=getPlayer(),item=option.create();
      if(!equipAdminItem(player,item)){status.textContent='No empty equipment slot available.';return;}
      const equipped=player.equipmentSlots.find(owned=>owned?.id===item.id);
      onChange(player);status.textContent=`${equipped.name} ${equipped.isSuper||equipped.awakened?'Super / Awakened':equipped.level>=equipped.maxLevel?'MAX':`LV ${equipped.level}`} equipped.`;
    });root.append(button);
  }
  const hint=document.createElement('p');hint.textContent="Malkuth's Hat unlock: defeat Arisu. Racer Pass is unlocked by default. Admin equips bypass locks.";
  root.append(hint,status);
}

import { beanBagBombSettings, beanBagBombLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration, artilleryExplosionReady } from './artillery-explosion.js';

/** Arcing throws settle on the ground; the 630-frame fuse counts from launch. */
export function createBeanBagBombAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=beanBagBombSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,bombs=[],explosions=[],shots=0;
 let sprite=null;
 const imageReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{sprite=new Image();sprite.onload=resolve;sprite.onerror=()=>{sprite=null;resolve();};sprite.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Bean Bag.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bombs=[];explosions=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,weapon,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const reach=Math.min(500,Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.45),targets=getAllEnemies().filter(enemy=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return Math.hypot(t.x-body.x,t.y-body.y)<=reach;});
  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'bean-bag-bomb',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets.length?getEnemyHurtbox(targets[Math.min(targets.length-1,Math.floor(random()*targets.length))]):null;
   const angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x):random()*Math.PI*2;
   const distance=target?Math.hypot(target.x-body.x,target.y-body.y):reach*(.2+.65*random());
   const spread=count>1?(i-(count-1)/2)*.2:0,a=angle+spread;
   bombs.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:body.x+Math.cos(a)*distance,toY:body.y+Math.sin(a)*distance,
    age:0,flight:Math.max(.15,distance/s.speed),radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function explode(bomb,player){
  explosions.push({x:bomb.x,y:bomb.y,radius:bomb.radius,age:0});
  for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){
   const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-bomb.x,dy=t.y-bomb.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
   if(distance>bomb.radius+extent)continue;
   const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bean-bag-bomb',s.damage,bomb.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:bomb.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bean-bag-bomb'});
   damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bean-bag-bomb');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta;while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,weapon,viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=explosions.length-1;i>=0;i--){explosions[i].age+=step;if(explosions[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)explosions.splice(i,1);}
   for(let i=bombs.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=bombs[i];b.age+=step;const p=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*p;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*p;
    if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8){explode(b,player);bombs.splice(i,1);}
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  for(const b of bombs){const flight=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight),arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*flight)*48,x=b.x-camera.x,y=b.y-camera.y,urgency=Math.max(0,(b.age-(s.duration-2))/2);
   context.save();context.fillStyle='rgba(15,30,50,.2)';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(x,y+6,10,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
   context.translate(x,y-arc);context.rotate(flight<1?b.age*6:Math.sin(b.age*12)*urgency*.08);
   if(sprite?.complete&&sprite.naturalWidth)context.drawImage(sprite,72,20,171,202,-12,-17,24,28);
   else {context.fillStyle='#b28a56';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(0,0,11,13,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();}
   context.strokeStyle='#ffc569';context.lineWidth=1.5;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(0,-12);context.quadraticCurveTo(8,-20,3,-24);context.stroke();
   context.fillStyle=`rgba(255,${Math.round(200-100*urgency)},65,${.6+.4*Math.sin(b.age*(12+urgency*14))**2})`;context.beginPath();context.arc(3,-24,2+urgency*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
  }
  for(const effect of explosions)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);
 }
 return {ready:Promise.all([imageReady,artilleryExplosionReady]),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get bombCount(){return bombs.length;},get explosionCount(){return explosions.length;}};
}

/** Sprite ellipses overlap a closed sector; sample its curved boundary without inflating hurtboxes. */
export function waterConeHits(body,x,y,angle,radius,halfAngle=waterDousingSettings.halfAngle){
 const dx=body.x-x,dy=body.y-y,relative=Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-angle),Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-angle));
 if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<=radius&&Math.abs(relative)<=halfAngle)return true;
 let previous={x,y};
 for(let i=0;i<=24;i++){
  const a=angle-halfAngle+2*halfAngle*i/24,next={x:x+Math.cos(a)*radius,y:y+Math.sin(a)*radius};

}

/** Sequential release makes a curved stream: older water is farther from the swing. */
export function waterStreamDroplets(splash){
 const drops=[],sweep=waterStreamSettings.sweepSeconds,travel=waterDousingSettings.duration;
 for(let i=0;i<waterStreamSettings.dropletCount;i++){

  if(age<0||age>=travel)continue;
  const angle=splash.angle-waterDousingSettings.halfAngle+release*waterDousingSettings.halfAngle*2;
  const progress=age/travel,origin=Math.min(14,splash.radius*.09),distance=origin+(splash.radius-origin)*progress;
  drops.push({x:splash.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:splash.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance,angle,age,release,distance,

}

export { startingLevelExp, expIncreasePerLevel } from './game-config.js';

// Level costs and formulas live in game-config.js.



/** Add round(15 + currentLevel / 2) to the next requirement on each level-up. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  return levelExpFormula(level);
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.pendingUpgrades ??= 0;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  syncRacerPassHealth(character);
  syncLifeJacketShield(character);
  character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield ?? 0));
  character.invincible ??= developmentSettings.invincible;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.pendingUpgrades++; // Each gained level gets its own choice, including overflow.
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  }
}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Add or remove shield points, capped by max HP without changing health. */
export function changePlayerShield(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount)) {
    character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield + Math.trunc(amount)));
  }
}

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
  const step = progress - motion.applied;
  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
  motion.applied = progress;
  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
// 1.5 seconds total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 1.3 seconds before the next swing.
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
  areaScale *= umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png';
  const ready = image.decode();
  // Composite the dense trail first, then blur once instead of per afterimage.
  const trailCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const trailCenter = Math.ceil(umbrellaSettings.reach + umbrellaSettings.trailBlur * 4 + 8);
  trailCanvas.width = trailCanvas.height = trailCenter * 2;
  const trailContext = trailCanvas.getContext('2d');
  let autoattackEnabled = true;
  let owner;
  let cycle = 0,stationaryScale=1;
  let swing;
  let clock = 0;
  const hitTimes = new Map();

  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep per configured attack interval. */
  function update(delta, player, aim, eraseProjectiles) {
    if (!autoattackEnabled) return;
    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); return; }
    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
    const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;
    cycle*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;stationaryScale=intervalScale;
    clock += delta;
    for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > umbrellaSettings.interval+umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown) hitTimes.delete(id);
    cycle = Math.max(0, cycle - delta);
    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) {
      if(player.tuningParts)playTrumpetTuning(player);
      const haste = 1; // Haste changes attack intervals, never swing duration or trails.
      const upgrades = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
      const swingAim=player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'plana-umbrella',aim):aim;
      swing = { aim:swingAim, areaScale: upgrades.areaScale, awakened: upgrades.awakened, elapsed: 0, previous: umbrellaSwingAngle(swingAim, 0), hits: new Set(), haste,
        duration: umbrellaSettings.duration / haste, linger: umbrellaSettings.trailLinger / haste };
      cycle = attackTimeFormula(umbrellaSettings.interval * upgrades.intervalMultiplier * stationaryScale, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
    }
    if (swing) {
      const wasAttacking = swing.elapsed < swing.duration;
      swing.elapsed += delta;

108:export function createTuningRun(){return {equipped:[null,null,null],excluded:new Set()};}
import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}
